description: Beyond boundaries and beyond Earth, Pectonic is on a mission to bring the universe closer through storytelling. We're building a digital experience that turns NASA's space discoveries into stories worth exploring.
summary: Not Forgotten is a digital archive of forgotten, retired and inactive NASA-era hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars. Each piece of hardware gets its own story: what it is, how it works, how it was deployed, and its status today. Browse and filter the archive, and read each story with its sources.
details:
Not Forgotten is a digital space museum you can browse. Humanity has left machines on other worlds, but their stories are scattered across separate reports, PDFs and archives. There is no single friendly place to explore what was left behind, and when instruments go quiet, their stories fade.

Our website gives each piece of hardware its own story page: what it is, how it works, how it was deployed, whether it is still operational, and why it matters. Visitors can browse the full archive and filter stories by category (such as science instrument or vehicle) and by status (operational, inactive, lost or unknown). Our stories include the lunar retroreflectors, lunar seismometers and lunar rovers, with more being added.

The project is built with React, Vite, React Router and Tailwind CSS for the website, designed with Google Stitch. A Node.js and Express API serves the stories from a Supabase database, and both the website and the API are hosted on Render. Our research draws on the NASA Image and Video Library and other NASA sources, and we credit each image.

Not Forgotten keeps the history of left-behind hardware alive. It is easy to explore, and built to grow with more stories.
